title: Program, Process & Administrative Redesign
governing_question: If the institutional architecture is right, how should Arkansas actually work for the person using it—and for the public servants operating it?
permanent_principle: A citizen should not need to understand the organizational chart of government to receive a legitimate public service.

locked_principles.citizen_not_org_chart: A citizen should not need to understand the organizational chart of government to receive a legitimate public service.
locked_principles.one_arkansas_front_door: Citizen-facing service layer over institutional architecture — not necessarily one giant agency. Concept only; no tech procurement.
locked_principles.tell_government_once: Reuse verified information where lawful, secure, appropriate, and consent-compatible.
locked_principles.data_reuse_counter_rule: Data reuse does not imply unrestricted data access.
locked_principles.public_decision_receipt: Consequential interactions produce a standardized Public Decision Receipt.
locked_principles.citizen_time_tax: Administrative burden consumes household prosperity even when no money changes hands.
locked_principles.business_friction_test: Does this burden accomplish a legitimate purpose proportionate to its cost?
locked_principles.rural_equivalence: Does this work for someone 45 minutes from the nearest service center with unreliable broadband?
locked_principles.accessibility_architecture: Good default design reduces unnecessary exceptional treatment; accommodations handle what remains.
locked_principles.graceful_failure: Systems must degrade to a less convenient but still functional pathway.

public_service_operating_standard: What am I trying to do?
What is happening while I wait?
What can I do if it is wrong?

one_arkansas_front_door.not: Not necessarily one giant agency; not a software procurement

tell_government_once.principle: Reuse verified information where lawful, secure, appropriate, and consent-compatible.
tell_government_once.counter_rule: Data reuse does not imply unrestricted data access.

no_black_box_government.ai_assistance: Disclosed where consequential; institutional responsibility remains; lineage; reason; appeal

citizen_time_tax.definition: Time government requires from a person to comply with or obtain something legitimately owed/available
